title: Predictors of flares in recent-onset psoriatic arthritis. Results of a multivariable model based on machine learning
summary: A prospective multicenter PsA cohort and cross-validated ML models identify patient/disease factors associated with subsequent flares; this is a specific clinical prediction result, while its associations remain observational.
ai_technology: Cross-validated machine-learning models for psoriatic-arthritis flare factors
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Cross-validated models in a prospective multicenter PsA cohort identified baseline factors associated with later flares; the reported associations are observational.
evidence.unknown: The reported evaluation does not establish prospective benefit or performance beyond the studied setting.
evidence.ai_role: Uses baseline clinical features in a prospective multicenter cohort to identify factors associated with subsequent PsA flares.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
